name: RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker
tagline: Design Roblox templates without fighting your tools.
description: Native Windows desktop editor for Roblox Classic R15 shirt and pants templates. Layer-based compositing, pattern and gradient region fills that wrap across connected panels, non-destructive image adjustments, word art, drawing tools, a 3D preview, and a large canvas that fills the window, built for the exact 585x559 template grid.

screenshots.caption: A finished shirt: one gradient across every panel, a drip, a collar, cuffs and Word Art, with the 3D preview
Home: tools, brush, placement, undo, file and recent projects
Background: presets, backgrounds, fill styles and template regions
Details: collars, cuffs, hems, seams, pockets and plackets
Text: Word Art with 15 fonts, six styles and a live preview

features: Pattern and gradient region fills (solid, linear, radial, stripes, checker, dots, camo) that wrap across connected panels and live-edit after painting
Non-destructive image adjustments (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, RGB channels)
Word art generator: 15 fonts, six styles, all bundled with the app
Clothing detail generators (collars, cuffs, hems, seams, pockets)
Built-in asset packs: 156 drips + 25 word art PNGs
Placement presets (Fit Front, F+B, Stretch, Allover, Scatter)
Eraser tool, and undo/redo of the full editor state
3D avatar preview that follows every edit
Autosave and crash recovery, recent projects with a taskbar jump list, open .r15proj files from Explorer, Ctrl+V paste as a layer
No accounts, no telemetry, no network requests; fonts are bundled
